chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Confronts Bai Lingmiao About the Second Spirit | Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 105
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang pieces together the truth: the veiled figure in his bed was Bai Lingmiao’s Second Spirit. An uncomfortable interrogation follows, revealing a dark rule about the bonds between mediums and their duplicates.
og_description: After a night of unsettling intimacy, Li Huowang confronts Bai Lingmiao about her other self. Who is the Second Spirit, and what does she want?
twitter_description: Li Huowang realizes the woman in his bed wasn’t Bai Lingmiao—it was her Second Spirit. The quiet confrontation that follows is one of the novel’s tensest scenes.
